text: TRAFFIC ALERT: Northbound and southbound I-35 between SH 71/Ben White Boulevard and SH 45 Southeast, varying nightly lane closures beginning Monday, Oct. 12 to Thursday, Oct. 15, from 8 p.m. to 5 a.m., for road work.
